finding.summary: http.Client.Timeout did not bound SSRF DNS inside CheckRedirect
finding.provenance: Independent readonly DNS review; Go1.27.3 net/http client.go redirect request uses original ireq.ctx, while send forks in Client.Timeout deadline
finding.deterministic_reproduction: Actual localhost httptest302 response redirects to net.DefaultResolver DNS blocker; configured client30ms remains blocked150ms before fix

change_scope: Only redirect context deadline block in security.go was edited by this follow-up. Other pending DNS edits in security.go belong to parent; no cache/existing DNS test edits.
fix: Derive validation-only context from current redirect request with previous response transport request deadline, preserving earlier current deadline and current cancellation; do not derive from previous context itself or mutate next request context.
regressions: previous response canceled context with still-future deadline is ignored
independent_review: Existing DNS/context diff retained URL/IP/CIDR/whitelist-only checks. Real local UDP DNS overlay passes canceled leader +4 active waiters for public and restricted answers; cancellation does not poison cache.
limits: No live public DNS requests required by new fixtures
No browser fallback claims: parent owns web_fetch delta
Prior response cancellation regression manually cancels its context; actual response body close is represented by that identical canceled state
